vt1102003.title: Nintendo Super Famicom Console SHVC-001 with 2 Controllers and Cables Japanese
vt1102003.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vt1102003.details: Nintendo Super Famicom home console (the Japanese model, with the back label in photo 2). Condition: pre-owned, labeled as having no noticeable scratches or stains. IMPORTANT: the body is yellowed from age and some dirt can be seen on the case (photos 1 and 2). The console is described as checked for operation, software is described as loading, and the buttons are described as not flattened. Shown in the photos: the console, two controllers, an AC adapter and cables (photo 1); the controllers and the cables are also partly visible in photo 2. The exact types of the cables are not stated, so please check the photos. No game software is included. The color may look different from the photos depending on the lighting. Please check all photos for the exact condition.
